entries.mechanism: Market returns depend on the difference between new evidence and expectations already reflected in prices, not on whether the observed news is good or bad in isolation.
applicability_conditions: pre-decision price and evidence context are available
the claimed surprise can be distinguished from the level of the reported fact
counterexamples: the price move is attributed to the event only because it occurred later

entries.mechanism: Changes in risk tolerance, leverage, liquidity, and financing constraints can reinforce or reverse market trends across broad and industry levels without a fixed periodic cycle.
applicability_conditions: point-in-time positioning or financing evidence is available
breadth and price context support the proposed transmission channel
counterexamples: a narrow constituent move explains the broad index
the financing or positioning observation is stale or only visible after the cutoff

entries.mechanism: A repeated story can coordinate attention and flows, while fast adoption and leveraged participation can also increase reversal risk; diffusion alone does not prove truth or persistence.
applicability_conditions: a timestamped multi-source corpus is available
the proposed price link names an observable attention, expectation, funding, or demand channel
counterexamples: independent fundamental evidence dominates and the narrative channel is unsupported
